# Serving and Inference Infrastructure {#sec-serving}

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" icon="false"}
**Chapter status: skeleton.**
:::

**Learning objectives.** After this chapter you can:

- reason about latency and throughput (streaming, batching, caching, KV-cache);
- estimate and control cost per request; know the levers (model choice, distillation, quantization, prompt caching);
- design the safety layer: input/output filtering, grounding checks, human-in-the-loop;
- describe deployment surfaces (API, gateway, self-hosted) and their governance trade-offs.
